# Signatories

## Project team

- **Jewoong Moon, Project Lead and primary contractor.** Responsible for learning-experience design, R and Quarto integration, reproducibility workflow, documentation, community coordination, and project reporting. Track record and current implementation are available in the [public R-LearnXR repository](https://github.com/Educatian/rlearnxr).
- **Co-lead or core project team member: to be confirmed before submission.** The selected person will bring R package maintenance, statistics education, accessibility, or empirical learning-evaluation experience; independently review delivery; oversee the pilot; and own at least one milestone outcome.

## Contributors

People who contribute lesson examples, accessibility review, code, or proposal feedback will be named here after confirming how they wish to be credited.

## Consulted

At least two R or Quarto educators or maintainers will review the need, scope, API, and reuse plan before submission. Attributable feedback or public evidence will be linked here. No external endorsement is claimed in this working draft.
